description: This file implements the NotificationHandler class for managing and sending notifications related to device status and parameter changes in a TR-069 host interface context. It includes methods for creating notifications, managing a queue, and interfacing with external components like cJSON and device info modules.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing device notifications, including queuing, callback registration, and notification creation for device status and parameter changes.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::NotificationHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notification queue.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::~NotificationHandler
methods.description: Destructor that releases the notification queue.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called upon notification updates.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::pushNotification
methods.description: Pushes a notification with specified destination and payload into the queue and triggers callback.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Creates and pushes a value change notification based on event data.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Creates and pushes a key-value notification.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Creates and pushes device management status notifications.

methods.name: NotificationHandler::push_device_deepsleep_notifications
methods.description: Creates and pushes deepsleep status notifications.
